verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs show pull requests with code review ('open Jira tickets right from the PR screen'), and a community report shows repositories can be made public. However, nothing in the evidence documents forking or accepting PRs from outside contributors' forks. missing for 10: documented repository forking, a fork-to-upstream pull request workflow, outside-contributor permissions for public repos, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an open-source-maintainer, I can let outside contributors fork my repository and propose changes back via pull requests

citations.quote: Comprehensive code review features to help you find and fix bugs before you deploy. Review large diffs with ease, view third-party code reports, and open Jira tickets right from the PR screen.
Too many PRs to review? Our AI code reviewer reviews all code changes and suggests fixes so you can merge faster.
